subject.title: perf(codex): reduce cold-start delay before first response

question: Should this protected Codex lifecycle change merge after real cold-start and cancellation evidence confirms that the eager acquire preserves the shared-client ownership contract?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes process-start timing in a compatibility-sensitive runtime path; tests show control flow but not the resulting process lifecycle or user-observed latency.

options.title: Require real runtime proof
options.body: Request a redacted cold-start timing comparison plus a cancellation or failed-preparation trace before deciding on merge.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused tests and build if the maintainer accepts the remaining lifecycle and performance uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require real runtime proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted cold-start timing comparison plus a cancellation or failed-preparation trace before deciding on merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The commit author is the clearest available routing candidate for the changed Codex app-server lifecycle.
